versions.content: If the PduR_MirrorTransmit returns E_NOT_OK , the Bus Mirroring module shall immediately remove the destination frame from the queue, shall report the runtime error MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next data item created in the currently active destination frame buffer.

If the PduR_MirrorTransmit returns E_NOT_OK , the Bus Mirroring module shall immediately remove the destination frame from the queue, shall report the runtime error Mirror.MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next data item created in the currently active destination frame buffer.

If the PduR_MirrorTransmit returns E_NOT_OK , the Bus Mirroring module shall immediately remove the destination frame from the queue, shall report the runtime error Mirror.MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next data item created in the currently active destination frame buffer.

If the PduR_MirrorTransmit returns E_NOT_OK , the Bus Mirroring module shall immediately remove the destination frame from the queue, shall report the runtime error MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next data item created in the currently active destination frame buffer.
